scenario: LUNI.3.1.5 — float and scientific numeric prefixes are admitted as UNIT_LIT. `1.5h`, `0.5_min`, `1e6s` and `1.0e3_ms` all parse as `time`-dimensioned values, so the program compiles. PINS ONLY THAT IT COMPILES: `compile_ok` does not read the integer-nanosecond constants or the truncation. The asymmetric `e`/`E`-start suffix rule keeps `1e6` (no trailing letter) as FLOAT_LIT while `1e6s` (trailing letter `s`) becomes UNIT_LIT with suffix `s`.
rules_ds:
schema Sensor scope ttl 1.5h:
    entity_id: String
    val: Int
    ts: Time

rule trig_float cooldown 0.5_min by: s.entity_id:
    Sensor s within 1e6s where s.val > 0
->
    log info "float-sci unit literals"

rule trig_sci cooldown 1.0e3_ms by: s.entity_id:
    Sensor s within 2_s where s.val > 0
->
    log info "float-sci unit literals (sci form)"
